works.publicNote: English song registered in London in 1932. The registration credits the music to Fritz Rotter and B. Kaper; Rotter was otherwise Kaper’s lyricist.

works.title: Just One of My Dreams
works.publicNote: English adaptation by Desmond Carter of a song with words by Fritz Rotter, registered in London in 1932 as a song and in arrangements for dance orchestra and for band.
